# Gexus
> Gexus is AI-assisted CAD software that runs in the browser. Describe a part in text, draw a sketch or upload an image, refine it with AI, and export a manufacturing-ready 3D model (STEP, STL, GLB and other formats). 3D CAD in 3 clicks.

## How it works
1. Describe: type a prompt, sketch or upload an image. Example: "Create an aluminum bracket for a servo motor with 35mm spacing and 3mm thickness."
2. Refine: iterate with AI and adjust dimensions, materials and details.
3. Export: download in industry standard formats (STEP, STL, GLB, others).

## What people make
- Brackets: mounts and fixings
- Enclosures: electronics and control boxes
- Chassis: robots and machinery
- Complete robots: from parts to products

## Features
- AI-assisted design: text, sketch or image to 3D
- Browser-based: no installation, works on laptop, tablet and phone
- Manufacturing-ready exports
- Team collaboration
- Private and secure: end-to-end encryption, private workspaces, your IP stays yours

## Who it is for
Engineers, makers, hardware startups and small manufacturers who need parts designed fast without legacy CAD's installation, licence cost and learning curve.
